statement.p: When air expands adiabatically (without gaining or losing heat), its pressure P and volume V are related by the equation PV^{1.4}=C where C is a constant. Suppose that at a certain instant the volume is 450 cubic centimeters and the pressure is 87 kPa and is decreasing at a rate of 8 kPa/minute. At what rate in cubic centimeters per minute is the volume increasing at this instant?
Note: Pa stands for Pascal. One Pa is equivalent to one \textrm{Newton}/\textrm{m}^2. kPa is a kiloPascal or 1000 Pascals.
